payload.reason: The evidence provides various tasks where BERT has been tested, demonstrating its generalization capabilities across different NLP tasks.

claims.text: BERT has been successfully applied to sentiment analysis, relation extraction, and word sense disambiguation, showcasing its versatility across multiple NLP tasks.
Transfer learning with BERT has been effective in low-resource settings for tasks such as machine translation and sequence tagging, indicating its adaptability.
The experiments show that fine-tuning BERT improves performance on the GLUE benchmark, which includes various classification tasks.
